name: Azurite.prodTree_eq_prod

theorem prodTree_eq_prod : ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (l : List α), prodTree fuel l = l.prod
  | 0, l => by rw [prodTree, foldl_mul_eq_mul_prod, one_mul]
  | _ + 1, [] => by simp [prodTree]
  | _ + 1, [x] => by simp [prodTree]

name: Azurite.map_detFn
statement:
theorem map_detFn {T : Type _} [CommRing T] (f : S →+* T) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℕ → S), f (detFn n M) = detFn n (fun i j => f (M i j))
  | 0, _ => by rw [detFn, detFn, map_one]
  | n + 1, M => by
    rw [detFn, detFn]
    -- push `f` through the additive fold
    have hfold : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (acc : S),
        f (l.foldl (fun a j => a + (-1) ^ j * M 0 j
            * detFn n (fun r c => M (r + 1) (if c < j then c else c + 1))) acc)
          = l.foldl (fun a j => a + (-1) ^ j * f (M 0 j)
            * detFn n (fun r c => f (M (r + 1) (if c < j then c else c + 1)))) (f acc)

    (hsh_lb : 1 ≤ sh) (hsh_ub : sh ≤ 63) (hcarry : carry.toNat < 2 ^ sh) :
    ((x <<< UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry).toNat
        + (x >>> UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat * 2 ^ 64
      = x.toNat * 2 ^ sh + carry.toNat
    ∧ (x >>> UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat < 2 ^ sh

name: Azurite.AzNat.add3SameLengthLimbs.go_correct
statement:
theorem add3SameLengthLimbs.go_correct (b c : Array UInt64) (loA loB loC len : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (c₁ c₂ : Bool)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) (hC : loC + len ≤ c.size) :
    toNatLimbsList
        (((add3SameLengthLimbs.go b c loA loB loC len a k c₁ c₂ hA hB hC).1.toList.drop
          (loA + k)).take (len - k))
      + ((add3SameLengthLimbs.go b c loA loB loC len a k c₁ c₂ hA hB hC).2.1.toNat
          + (add3SameLengthLimbs.go b c loA loB loC len a k c₁ c₂ hA hB hC).2.2.toNat)
        * 2 ^ (64 * (len - k))
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop (loA + k)).take (len - k))
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop (loB + k)).take (len - k))
        + toNatLimbsList ((c.toList.drop (loC + k)).take (len - k))
        + c₁.toNat + c₂.toNat

theorem add3SameLengthLimbs.go_toList_take_le (b c : Array UInt64) (loA loB loC len : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (c₁ c₂ : Bool)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) (hC : loC + len ≤ c.size)
    (m : Nat) (hm : m ≤ loA + k) :
    (add3SameLengthLimbs.go b c loA loB loC len a k c₁ c₂ hA hB hC).1.toList.take m
      = a.toList.take m

name: Azurite.AzNat.addGeqLimbs_toNat
statement:
theorem addGeqLimbs_toNat (a b : Array UInt64) (loA lenA loB lenB : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size)
    (h_ge : lenB ≤ lenA) (h_posA : 0 < lenA) (h_posB : 0 < lenB) :
    let (a', c) := addGeqLimbs a b loA lenA loB lenB hA hB h_ge h_posA h_posB
    toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop loA).take lenA) + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * lenA)
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop loA).take lenA)
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop loB).take lenB)

name: Azurite.AzNat.addLimb.go_correct
statement:
theorem addLimb.go_correct (hi : Nat) (a : Array UInt64) (i : Nat)
    (carry : UInt64) (h_size : hi ≤ a.size)
    (hcarry : carry.toNat ≤ 1 ∨ i < hi) :
    toNatLimbsList (((addLimb.go hi a i carry h_size).1.toList.drop i).take (hi - i))
      + (addLimb.go hi a i carry h_size).2.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * (hi - i))
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop i).take (hi - i)) + carry.toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.addLimb.go_toList_take
statement:
theorem addLimb.go_toList_take (hi : Nat) (a : Array UInt64) (i : Nat)
    (carry : UInt64) (h_size : hi ≤ a.size) :

name: Azurite.AzNat.addLimb_toList_take
statement:
theorem addLimb_toList_take (a : Array UInt64) (lo hi : Nat) (b : UInt64)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ a.size) :
    (addLimb a lo hi b hlo hhi).1.toList.take lo = a.toList.take lo

name: Azurite.AzNat.addLimb_toNat
statement:
theorem addLimb_toNat (a : Array UInt64) (lo hi : Nat) (b : UInt64)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ a.size) (h_lo_lt : lo < hi) :
    let (a', c) := addLimb a lo hi b hlo hhi
    toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop lo).take (hi - lo))
        + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * (hi - lo))
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take (hi - lo)) + b.toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.addLimbs_toNat
statement:
theorem addLimbs_toNat (a b : Array UInt64) (loA lenA loB lenB : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size)
    (h_posA : 0 < lenA) (h_posB : 0 < lenB) :
    let (r, c) := addLimbs a b loA lenA loB lenB hA hB h_posA h_posB
    let lenMax := max lenA lenB
    let loMax := if lenB ≤ lenA then loA else loB
    toNatLimbsList ((r.toList.drop loMax).take lenMax) + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * lenMax)
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop loA).take lenA)
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop loB).take lenB)

name: Azurite.AzNat.addSameLengthLimbs.go_correct
statement:
theorem addSameLengthLimbs.go_correct (b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (carry : Bool)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    toNatLimbsList
        (((addSameLengthLimbs.go b loA loB len a k carry hA hB).1.toList.drop (loA + k)).take
          (len - k))
      + (addSameLengthLimbs.go b loA loB len a k carry hA hB).2.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * (len - k))
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop (loA + k)).take (len - k))
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop (loB + k)).take (len - k))
        + carry.toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.addSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_drop

name: Azurite.AzNat.addSameLengthLimbs_toNat
statement:
theorem addSameLengthLimbs_toNat (a b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    let (a', c) := addSameLengthLimbs a b loA loB len hA hB
    toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop loA).take len) + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * len)
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop loA).take len)
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop loB).take len)

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_drop_take_split
statement:
lemma toNatLimbsList_drop_take_split (arr : Array UInt64)
    (lo lenA lenB : Nat) (h_ge : lenB ≤ lenA) (h_bound : lo + lenA ≤ arr.size) :
    toNatLimbsList ((arr.toList.drop lo).take lenA)
      = toNatLimbsList ((arr.toList.drop lo).take lenB)
        + toNatLimbsList ((arr.toList.drop (lo + lenB)).take (lenA - lenB)) * 2 ^ (64 * lenB)

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_take_succ

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_eq_of_drop_eq
statement:
lemma compare_eq_of_drop_eq (l1 l2 : List UInt64) (i : Nat) (h1 : i < l1.length) (h2 : i < l2.length)
  (h_drop : l1.drop (i + 1) = l2.drop (i + 1)) :
  Ord.compare (toNatLimbsList l1) (toNatLimbsList l2) =
    if (l1.get ⟨i, h1⟩).toNat < (l2.get ⟨i, h2⟩).toNat then Ordering.lt
    else if (l1.get ⟨i, h1⟩).toNat > (l2.get ⟨i, h2⟩).toNat then Ordering.gt
    else Ord.compare (toNatLimbsList (l1.take i)) (toNatLimbsList (l2.take i))

name: UInt64.subWithBorrow_one_eq
statement:
theorem subWithBorrow_one_eq (a b : UInt64) :
  (subWithBorrow a b true).1.toNat + b.toNat + 1 =
    a.toNat + (if (subWithBorrow a b true).2 then 1 else 0) * 2^64

name: UInt64.subWithBorrow_zero_eq
statement:
theorem subWithBorrow_zero_eq (a b : UInt64) :
  (subWithBorrow a b false).1.toNat + b.toNat + 0 =
    a.toNat + (if (subWithBorrow a b false).2 then 1 else 0) * 2^64

name: Azurite.AzNat.limb_sub_step
statement:
lemma limb_sub_step (x borrow : UInt64) :
    x.toNat + (if x < borrow then (1 : UInt64) else 0).toNat * 2 ^ 64
      = (x - borrow).toNat + borrow.toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.ofNat_sub
statement: theorem ofNat_sub (m n : Nat) : ofNat (m - n) = ofNat m - ofNat n

name: Azurite.AzNat.ofNat_subUInt64
statement:
theorem ofNat_subUInt64 (n : Nat) (b : UInt64) :
    ofNat (n - b.toNat) = (ofNat n).subUInt64 b

name: Azurite.AzNat.subGeqLimbs_high_le
statement:
theorem subGeqLimbs_high_le (a b : Array UInt64) (loA lenA loB lenB : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size)
    (h_ge : lenB ≤ lenA) (h_posA : 0 < lenA) (h_posB : 0 < lenB)
    (split : Nat) (h_split : split ≤ lenA)
    (h_no_borrow : (subGeqLimbs a b loA lenA loB lenB hA hB h_ge h_posA h_posB).2 = false) :
    toNatLimbsList (((subGeqLimbs a b loA lenA loB lenB hA hB h_ge h_posA h_posB).1.toList.drop
        (loA + split)).take (lenA - split))
      ≤ toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop (loA + split)).take (lenA - split))

name: Azurite.AzNat.subGeqLimbs_toNat
statement:
theorem subGeqLimbs_toNat (a b : Array UInt64) (loA lenA loB lenB : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size)
    (h_ge : lenB ≤ lenA) (h_posA : 0 < lenA) (h_posB : 0 < lenB) :
    let (a', c) := subGeqLimbs a b loA lenA loB lenB hA hB h_ge h_posA h_posB
    toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop loA).take lenA) + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * lenA)
      = toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop loA).take lenA)
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop loB).take lenB)

name: Azurite.AzNat.subLimb.go_toList_take
statement:
theorem subLimb.go_toList_take (hi : Nat) (a : Array UInt64) (i : Nat)
    (borrow : UInt64) (h_size : hi ≤ a.size) :
    (subLimb.go hi a i borrow h_size).1.toList.take i = a.toList.take i

name: Azurite.AzNat.subLimb_toList_take
statement:
theorem subLimb_toList_take (a : Array UInt64) (lo hi : Nat) (b : UInt64)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ a.size) :
    (subLimb a lo hi b hlo hhi).1.toList.take lo = a.toList.take lo

name: Azurite.AzNat.subLimb_toNat
statement:
theorem subLimb_toNat (a : Array UInt64) (lo hi : Nat) (b : UInt64)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ a.size) (h_lo_lt : lo < hi) :
    let (a', c) := subLimb a lo hi b hlo hhi
    toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take (hi - lo))
        + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * (hi - lo))
      = toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop lo).take (hi - lo)) + b.toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.subSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_drop
statement:
theorem subSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_drop (b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (borrow : Bool)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    (subSameLengthLimbs.go b loA loB len a k borrow hA hB).1.toList.drop (loA + len)
      = a.toList.drop (loA + len)

name: Azurite.AzNat.subSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_take
statement:
theorem subSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_take (b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (borrow : Bool)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    (subSameLengthLimbs.go b loA loB len a k borrow hA hB).1.toList.take (loA + k)
      = a.toList.take (loA + k)

name: Azurite.AzNat.subSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_take_le
statement:
theorem subSameLengthLimbs.go_toList_take_le (b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (borrow : Bool)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size)
    (m : Nat) (hm : m ≤ loA + k) :
    (subSameLengthLimbs.go b loA loB len a k borrow hA hB).1.toList.take m
      = a.toList.take m

name: Azurite.AzNat.subSameLengthLimbs_high_le
statement:
theorem subSameLengthLimbs_high_le (a b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size)
    (split : Nat) (h_split : split ≤ len)
    (h_no_borrow : (subSameLengthLimbs a b loA loB len hA hB).2 = false) :
    toNatLimbsList (((subSameLengthLimbs a b loA loB len hA hB).1.toList.drop
        (loA + split)).take (len - split))
      ≤ toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop (loA + split)).take (len - split))

name: Azurite.AzNat.subSameLengthLimbs_toNat
statement:
theorem subSameLengthLimbs_toNat (a b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    let (a', c) := subSameLengthLimbs a b loA loB len hA hB
    toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop loA).take len) + c.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * len)
      = toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop loA).take len)
        + toNatLimbsList ((b.toList.drop loB).take len)

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_sub
statement: theorem toNat_sub (a b : AzNat) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_subUInt64

theorem toNat_subUInt64 (a : AzNat) (b : UInt64) :

theorem toNatLimbsList_extract' (a : Array UInt64) (lo n : Nat) :

theorem toNat_eq_two_pow_of_size (s : AzNat) (h1 : s.size = N + 1) (h2 : s.isPowerOfTwo = true) :

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toNat_le_two_pow_of_size

name: Azurite.BZ.IsPrincipalRoot.inv
statement: theorem inv (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) : IsPrincipalRoot (ω ^ (K - 1)) K

name: Azurite.BZ.IsPrincipalRoot.pow_mod
statement: theorem pow_mod (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) (m : ℕ) : ω ^ m = ω ^ (m % K)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsPrincipalRoot.sum_pow_mul
statement:
theorem sum_pow_mul (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range K, ω ^ (m * j) = if m % K = 0 then (K : R) else 0

name: Azurite.BZ.dftInv_dft
statement:
theorem dftInv_dft {ω : R} {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) (a : Fin K → R) :
    dftInv ω (dft ω a) = fun i => (K : R) * a i

name: Azurite.BZ.dftInv_dft_apply
statement:
theorem dftInv_dft_apply {ω : R} {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) (a : Fin K → R)
    (i : Fin K) : dftInv ω (dft ω a) i = (K : R) * a i

name: Azurite.BZ.dft_dft
statement:
theorem dft_dft {ω : R} {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) (a : Fin K → R) :
    dft ω (dft ω a) = fun i => (K : R) * a (-i)

name: Azurite.BZ.dft_dft_apply
statement:
theorem dft_dft_apply {ω : R} {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω K) (a : Fin K → R)
    (i : Fin K) : dft ω (dft ω a) i = (K : R) * a (-i)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsPrincipalRoot.natCast_mul_one_add_pow_half
statement:
theorem natCast_mul_one_add_pow_half {ω : R} {m : ℕ} (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω (2 * m)) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (m : R) * (1 + ω ^ m) = 0

name: Azurite.BZ.IsPrincipalRoot.pow_half_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem pow_half_eq_neg_one {ω : R} {m : ℕ} (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω (2 * m)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hu : IsUnit (m : R)) : ω ^ m = -1

name: Azurite.BZ.backwardFFT_congr
statement:
theorem backwardFFT_congr (k : ℕ) (ω : R) : ∀ (a b : ℕ → R) (j : ℕ), j < 2 ^ k →
    (∀ s, s < 2 ^ k → a s = b s) → backwardFFT ω k a j = backwardFFT ω k b j

name: Azurite.BZ.backwardFFT_eq_dftNat
statement:
theorem backwardFFT_eq_dftNat (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (ω : R) (a x : ℕ → R) (j : ℕ), ω ^ 2 ^ k = -1 →
      (∀ r, r < 2 ^ (k + 1) → a r = x (bitrev (k + 1) r)) → j < 2 ^ (k + 1) →
      backwardFFT ω (k + 1) a j = dftNat (ω ^ (2 ^ (k + 1) - 1)) (2 ^ (k + 1)) x j

name: Azurite.BZ.backwardFFT_forwardFFT
statement:
theorem backwardFFT_forwardFFT (k : ℕ) {ω : R} (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω (2 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hu : IsUnit ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : R)) (x : Fin (2 ^ (k + 1)) → R) (j : Fin (2 ^ (k + 1))) :
    backwardFFT ω (k + 1) (forwardFFT ω (k + 1) (extendZero x)) j
      = ((2 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : R) * x j

name: Azurite.BZ.bitrev_bitrev
statement: theorem bitrev_bitrev (k j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 ^ k) : bitrev k (bitrev k j) = j

name: Azurite.BZ.bitrev_lt
statement: theorem bitrev_lt (k j : ℕ) : bitrev k j < 2 ^ k

name: Azurite.BZ.bitrev_succ_of_lt
statement: theorem bitrev_succ_of_lt (k r : ℕ) (hr : r < 2 ^ k) : bitrev (k + 1) r = 2 * bitrev k r

name: Azurite.BZ.bitrev_succ_pow_add
statement:
theorem bitrev_succ_pow_add (k r : ℕ) (hr : r < 2 ^ k) :
    bitrev (k + 1) (2 ^ k + r) = 2 * bitrev k r + 1

name: Azurite.BZ.bitrev_two_mul
statement: theorem bitrev_two_mul (k j : ℕ) : bitrev (k + 1) (2 * j) = bitrev k j

name: Azurite.BZ.bitrev_two_mul_add_one
statement: theorem bitrev_two_mul_add_one (k j : ℕ) : bitrev (k + 1) (2 * j + 1) = 2 ^ k + bitrev k j

name: Azurite.BZ.dft_eq_dftNat
statement:
theorem dft_eq_dftNat {K : ℕ} (ω : R) (a : Fin K → R) (i : Fin K) :
    dft ω a i = dftNat ω K (extendZero a) i

name: Azurite.BZ.fftRecSub_eq_dftNat
statement:
theorem fftRecSub_eq_dftNat (k : ℕ) (ω : R) (hω : ω ^ (2 ^ k) = -1) (a : ℕ → R) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < 2 ^ (k + 1)) : fftRecSub ω (k + 1) a i = dftNat ω (2 ^ (k + 1)) a i

name: Azurite.BZ.fftRecSub_eq_dftNat_of_principal
statement:
theorem fftRecSub_eq_dftNat_of_principal (k : ℕ) {ω : R} (h : IsPrincipalRoot ω (2 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hu : IsUnit ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : R)) (a : ℕ → R) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < 2 ^ (k + 1)) :
    fftRecSub ω (k + 1) a i = dftNat ω (2 ^ (k + 1)) a i

name: Azurite.BZ.fftRecSub_eq_fftRec
statement:
theorem fftRecSub_eq_fftRec (k : ℕ) (ω : R) (hω : ω ^ (2 ^ k) = -1) (a : ℕ → R) :
    fftRecSub ω (k + 1) a = fftRec ω (k + 1) a

name: Azurite.BZ.fftRec_eq_dftNat
statement:
theorem fftRec_eq_dftNat (k : ℕ) (ω : R) (hω : ω ^ (2 ^ k) = 1) (a : ℕ → R) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < 2 ^ k) : fftRec ω k a i = dftNat ω (2 ^ k) a i

name: Azurite.BZ.fft_eq_dft
statement:
theorem fft_eq_dft (k : ℕ) (ω : R) (hω : ω ^ (2 ^ k) = 1) (a : Fin (2 ^ k) → R) :
    fft k ω a = dft ω a

name: Azurite.BZ.forwardFFT_eq_dft
statement:
theorem forwardFFT_eq_dft (k : ℕ) (ω : R) (hω : ω ^ 2 ^ k = -1) (a : Fin (2 ^ (k + 1)) → R)
    (r : Fin (2 ^ (k + 1))) :
    forwardFFT ω (k + 1) (extendZero a) r = dft ω a ⟨bitrev (k + 1) r, bitrev_lt _ _⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.forwardFFT_eq_dftNat
statement:
theorem forwardFFT_eq_dftNat (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (ω : R) (a : ℕ → R) (r : ℕ), ω ^ 2 ^ k = -1 → r < 2 ^ (k + 1) →
      forwardFFT ω (k + 1) a r = dftNat ω (2 ^ (k + 1)) a (bitrev (k + 1) r)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsPrincipalRoot.of_pow_two_pow_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem IsPrincipalRoot.of_pow_two_pow_eq_neg_one {ω : R} (k : ℕ) (h : ω ^ 2 ^ k = -1) :
    IsPrincipalRoot ω (2 ^ (k + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.backwardFFT_forwardFFT_weight_mul
statement:
theorem backwardFFT_forwardFFT_weight_mul (k : ℕ) {θ : R} (hθ : θ ^ 2 ^ (k + 1) = -1)
    (a b : Fin (2 ^ (k + 1)) → R) (i : Fin (2 ^ (k + 1))) :
    backwardFFT (θ ^ 2) (k + 1) (fun r =>
        forwardFFT (θ ^ 2) (k + 1) (extendZero (weight θ a)) r
          * forwardFFT (θ ^ 2) (k + 1) (extendZero (weight θ b)) r) i
      = ((2 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : R) * (θ ^ i.val * negacyclicConv a b i)

name: Azurite.BZ.cyclicConv_weight
statement:
theorem cyclicConv_weight {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] {θ : R} (hθ : θ ^ K = -1) (a b : Fin K → R)
    (i : Fin K) : cyclicConv (weight θ a) (weight θ b) i = θ ^ i.val * negacyclicConv a b i

name: Azurite.BZ.dftInv_dft_weight_mul
statement:
theorem dftInv_dft_weight_mul {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] {θ : R} (hθ : θ ^ K = -1)
    (hω : IsPrincipalRoot (θ ^ 2) K) (a b : Fin K → R) (i : Fin K) :
    dftInv (θ ^ 2) (fun j => dft (θ ^ 2) (weight θ a) j * dft (θ ^ 2) (weight θ b) j) i
      = (K : R) * (θ ^ i.val * negacyclicConv a b i)

name: Azurite.BZ.dft_cyclicConv
statement:
theorem dft_cyclicConv {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] {ω : R} (hω : ω ^ K = 1) (a b : Fin K → R)
    (j : Fin K) : dft ω (cyclicConv a b) j = dft ω a j * dft ω b j

name: Azurite.BZ.geom_sum_two_pow
statement:
theorem geom_sum_two_pow (τ : R) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (2 ^ k), τ ^ j = ∏ t ∈ range k, (1 + τ ^ 2 ^ t)

name: Azurite.BZ.int_recover_of_mem_window
statement:
theorem int_recover_of_mem_window {c U N : ℤ} (hU0 : 0 ≤ U) (hUN : U ≤ N) (hlo : U - N ≤ c)
    (hhi : c < U) : c = if U ≤ c % N then c % N - N else c % N

name: Azurite.BZ.negacyclicConv_bounds
statement:
theorem negacyclicConv_bounds {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (B : ℤ) (hB : 0 < B) (a b : Fin K → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ ℓ, 0 ≤ a ℓ ∧ a ℓ < B) (hb : ∀ m, 0 ≤ b m ∧ b m < B) (j : Fin K) :
    -(((K - 1 - j.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * B ^ 2) ≤ negacyclicConv a b j
      ∧ negacyclicConv a b j < ((j.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * B ^ 2

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_cyclicConv
statement:
theorem sum_cyclicConv {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (a b : Fin K → R) :
    ∑ i, cyclicConv a b i = (∑ ℓ, a ℓ) * (∑ m, b m)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_weight_mul_sum_weight
statement:
theorem sum_weight_mul_sum_weight {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] {θ : R} (hθ : θ ^ K = -1)
    (a b : Fin K → R) :
    (∑ ℓ, θ ^ ℓ.val * a ℓ) * (∑ m, θ ^ m.val * b m)
      = ∑ j, θ ^ j.val * negacyclicConv a b j

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_eq_neg_one_zmod
statement: theorem two_pow_eq_neg_one_zmod (n : ℕ) : (2 : ZMod (2 ^ n + 1)) ^ n = -1

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_add

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_add'
statement: theorem toZMod_add' (a b : AzFermat N) : toZMod (add a b) = toZMod a + toZMod b

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_butterfly_fst
statement:
theorem toZMod_butterfly_fst [NeZero N] (t : Nat) (b c : AzFermat N) :
    toZMod (butterfly t b c).1 = toZMod b + toZMod c * 2 ^ t

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_butterfly_snd
statement:
theorem toZMod_butterfly_snd [NeZero N] (t : Nat) (b c : AzFermat N) :
    toZMod (butterfly t b c).2 = toZMod b - toZMod c * 2 ^ t

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_divPow2_mul_two_pow
statement:
theorem toZMod_divPow2_mul_two_pow [NeZero N] (t : Nat) (a : AzFermat N) :
    toZMod (divPow2 t a) * 2 ^ t = toZMod a

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_highPart
statement:
theorem toZMod_highPart (p : AzNat) (hp : p.toNat / 2 ^ N ≤ 2 ^ N) :
    toZMod (highPart p hp) = ((p.toNat / 2 ^ N : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_injective
statement: theorem toZMod_injective : Function.Injective (toZMod (N := N))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_lowPart
statement: theorem toZMod_lowPart (p : AzNat) : toZMod (lowPart p) = ((p.toNat % 2 ^ N : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_mk
statement:
theorem toZMod_mk (v : AzNat) (h : v.toNat ≤ 2 ^ N) :
    toZMod (⟨v, h⟩ : AzFermat N) = (v.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_mulPow2
statement:
theorem toZMod_mulPow2 [NeZero N] (t : Nat) (a : AzFermat N) :
    toZMod (mulPow2 t a) = toZMod a * 2 ^ t

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_mulPow2Le
statement:
theorem toZMod_mulPow2Le (t : Nat) (ht : t ≤ N) (negate : Bool) (a : AzFermat N) :
    toZMod (mulPow2Le t ht negate a)
      = if negate then -(toZMod a * 2 ^ t) else toZMod a * 2 ^ t

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_mulPow2Split
statement:
theorem toZMod_mulPow2Split [NeZero N] (t : Nat) (a : AzFermat N) :
    toZMod (mulPow2Split t a).1
      = if (mulPow2Split t a).2 then -(toZMod a * 2 ^ t) else toZMod a * 2 ^ t

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_mulWith
statement:
theorem toZMod_mulWith [NeZero N] (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat) (a b : AzFermat N)
    (hmul : (mulFn a.val b.val).toNat = a.val.toNat * b.val.toNat) :
    toZMod (mulWith mulFn a b) = toZMod a * toZMod b

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_neg
statement: theorem toZMod_neg (a : AzFermat N) : toZMod (-a) = -toZMod a

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_neg'
statement: theorem toZMod_neg' (a : AzFermat N) : toZMod (neg a) = -toZMod a

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_ofAzNat
statement:
theorem toZMod_ofAzNat [NeZero N] (n : AzNat) :
    toZMod (ofAzNat N n) = (n.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_reduceAny
statement:
theorem toZMod_reduceAny [NeZero N] (p : AzNat) :
    toZMod (reduceAny p) = (p.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_reduceSplit
statement:
theorem toZMod_reduceSplit (negate : Bool) (p : AzNat) (hp : p.toNat / 2 ^ N ≤ 2 ^ N) :
    toZMod (reduceSplit negate p hp)
      = if negate then -(p.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1)) else (p.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1))

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_sub
statement: theorem toZMod_sub (a b : AzFermat N) : toZMod (a - b) = toZMod a - toZMod b

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_sub'
statement: theorem toZMod_sub' (a b : AzFermat N) : toZMod (sub a b) = toZMod a - toZMod b

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_backwardFFT
statement:
theorem toZMod_backwardFFT (e k : Nat) (a : Array (AzFermat N)) (ha : a.size = 2 ^ k) (r : Nat)
    (hr : r < 2 ^ k) :
    toZMod ((backwardFFT e k a ha)[r]'(Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq hr (backwardFFT_size e k a ha).symm))
      = BZ.backwardFFT ((2 : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1)) ^ e) k (toZModFun a) r

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_backwardFFTRec
statement:
theorem toZMod_backwardFFTRec (e : Nat) : ∀ (k : Nat) (a : Array (AzFermat N))
    (ha : a.size = 2 ^ k) (r : Nat) (hr : r < 2 ^ k),
    toZMod ((backwardFFTRec e k a ha).1[r]'(Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq hr (backwardFFTRec e k a ha).2.symm))
      = BZ.backwardFFT ((2 : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1)) ^ e) k (toZModFun a) r

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_forwardFFT

theorem toZMod_forwardFFT (e k : Nat) (a : Array (AzFermat N)) (ha : a.size = 2 ^ k) (r : Nat)
    (hr : r < 2 ^ k) :
    toZMod ((forwardFFT e k a ha)[r]'(Nat.lt_of_lt_of_eq hr (forwardFFT_size e k a ha).symm))
      = BZ.forwardFFT ((2 : ZMod (2 ^ N + 1)) ^ e) k (toZModFun a) r

name: Azurite.AzFermat.toZMod_forwardFFTRec

theorem toZMod_forwardFFTRec (e : Nat) : ∀ (k : Nat) (a : Array (AzFermat N)) (ha : a.size = 2 ^ k)

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftRightRound_fst
statement:
theorem AzNat.shiftRightRound_fst (n : AzNat) (mode : RoundingMode) (sh : Nat) :
    (n.shiftRightRound mode sh).1 =
      match mode with
      | .Floor | .Down => n.shiftRight sh
      | .Ceiling | .Up =>
        if n.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then n.shiftRight sh
        else (n.shiftRight sh).addUInt64 1
      | .Nearest =>
        if sh = 0 then n
        else if n.testBit (sh - 1) then
          if n.isMultipleOfPow2 (sh - 1) then
            let shifted := n.shiftRight sh
            if shifted.isOdd then shifted.addUInt64 1 else shifted
          else
            (n.shiftRight sh).addUInt64 1
        else
          n.shiftRight sh

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftRightRound_snd
statement:
theorem AzNat.shiftRightRound_snd (n : AzNat) (mode : RoundingMode) (sh : Nat) :
    (n.shiftRightRound mode sh).2 =
      match mode with
      | .Floor | .Down => if n.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then .eq else .lt
      | .Ceiling | .Up => if n.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then .eq else .gt
      | .Nearest =>
        if sh = 0 then .eq
        else if n.testBit (sh - 1) then
          if n.isMultipleOfPow2 (sh - 1) then
            if (n.shiftRight sh).isOdd then .gt else .lt
          else
            .gt
        else
          if n.isMultipleOfPow2 sh then .eq else .lt

name: Azurite.AzVector.parseElementsN_intercalate
statement:
lemma parseElementsN_intercalate :
    ∀ (xs : List R),
      parseElementsN xs.length
        (List.intercalate [',', ' '] (xs.map ParsableElement.toChars)) = some xs
  | [] => rfl
  | [r] => by
    simp only [List.length_singleton, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.intercalate_singleton]
    show parseElementsN 1 (ParsableElement.toChars r) = some [r]
    simp [parseElementsN, ParsableElement.parse_toChars]
  | r :: r' :: rs => by
    have hnc_r : ',' ∉ ParsableElement.toChars r := ParsableElement.toChars_no_comma r
    have hmap_ne : ((r' :: rs).map ParsableElement.toChars) ≠ [] := by simp
    show parseElementsN (rs.length + 2)
        (List.intercalate [',', ' '] ((r :: r' :: rs).map ParsableElement.toChars)) =
        some (r :: r' :: rs)
    rw [show ((r :: r' :: rs).map ParsableElement.toChars : List (List Char)) =
      ParsableElement.toChars r :: ((r' :: rs).map ParsableElement.toChars) from rfl,
      List.intercalate_cons_of_ne_nil hmap_ne]
    set tcr

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.parseRowsN_intercalate
statement:
lemma parseRowsN_intercalate :
    ∀ (rows : List (List R)),
      (∀ row ∈ rows, row.length = n) →
      parseRowsN n rows.length
        (List.intercalate [';', ' '] (rows.map (fun row =>
          List.intercalate [',', ' '] (row.map ParsableElement.toChars)))) =
        some rows
  | [], _ => rfl
  | [row], hlen => by
    simp only [List.length_singleton, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
      List.intercalate_singleton]
    show parseRowsN n 1
      (List.intercalate [',', ' '] (row.map ParsableElement.toChars)) = some [row]
    have hrow : row.length = n := hlen row (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
    have h := parseElementsN_intercalate row
    rw [hrow] at h
    simp [parseRowsN, h]
  | row :: row' :: rs, hlen => by
    have hnc_row : ';' ∉ List.intercalate [',', ' '] (row.map ParsableElement.toChars) :=
      no_semi_in_intercalate_row row
    have hmap_ne :
        ((row' :: rs).map
          (fun r => List.intercalate [',', ' '] (r.map ParsableElement.toChars))) ≠ [] := by
      simp
    show parseRowsN n (rs.length + 2)
        (List.intercalate [';', ' '] ((row :: row' :: rs).map
          (fun r => List.intercalate [',', ' '] (r.map ParsableElement.toChars)))) =
        some (row :: row' :: rs)
    rw [show ((row :: row' :: rs).map
        (fun r => List.intercalate [',', ' '] (r.map ParsableElement.toChars)) :
        List (List Char)) =
      (List.intercalate [',', ' '] (row.map ParsableElement.toChars)) ::
        ((row' :: rs).map
          (fun r => List.intercalate [',', ' '] (r.map ParsableElement.toChars))) from rfl,
      List.intercalate_cons_of_ne_nil hmap_ne]
    set rowChars

name: Azurite.AzNat.exactDivOddLimbs.go_toNat
statement:
theorem exactDivOddLimbs.go_toNat (d dinv : UInt64) (hinv : d * dinv = 1) (a : Array UInt64)
    (lo len : Nat) (hA : lo + len ≤ a.size) (Q : Nat) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (acc : Array UInt64) (i : Nat) (hi : UInt64) (borrow : Bool), len - i = n →
      i ≤ len → acc.size = i → toNatLimbsList acc.toList = Q % 2 ^ (64 * i) →
      sliceVal a (lo + i) (len - i)
        = hi.toNat + (if borrow then 1 else 0) + d.toNat * (Q / 2 ^ (64 * i)) →
      toNatLimbsList (exactDivOddLimbs.go d dinv a lo len hA acc i hi borrow).toList
        = Q % 2 ^ (64 * len)

    toNatLimbsList (exactDivOddLimbs d dinv a lo len hA).toList = Q

name: Azurite.BPR.lemma_1_11_degU

theorem lemma_1_11_degU (P Q : K[X]) (k : ℕ) (i : ℕ)

name: Azurite.BPR.lemma_1_14
statement:
theorem lemma_1_14 [IsAlgClosed C] [Algebra K C] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq C]
    (P_fam Q_fam : List K[X]) (hP : listGcd P_fam ≠ 0) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : (listGcd P_fam).natDegree < d) :
    (∃ x : C, (∀ P ∈ P_fam, aeval x P = 0) ∧ (∀ Q ∈ Q_fam, aeval x Q ≠ 0)) ↔
      (gcd (listGcd P_fam) (Q_fam.prod ^ d)).natDegree ≠ (listGcd P_fam).natDegree

    (∃ x : C, aeval x P = 0 ∧ aeval x Q ≠ 0) ↔ (gcd P (Q ^ d)).natDegree ≠ P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_1_9
statement:
theorem proposition_1_9 {P Q G : K[X]}
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hG : IsGCD G P Q)
    (hnd_gP : G.natDegree < P.natDegree)
    (hnd_gQ : G.natDegree < Q.natDegree) :
    ∃ U V : K[X],
      U * P + V * Q = G ∧
      U.natDegree < Q.natDegree - G.natDegree ∧
      V.natDegree < P.natDegree - G.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_1_9_aux

    (hG : IsGCD G P Q)
    (hnd_g : G.natDegree < Q.natDegree) :
    ∃ U V : K[X],
      U * P + V * Q = G ∧
      U.natDegree < Q.natDegree - G.natDegree ∧
      V.natDegree < P.natDegree - G.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.pRem_exists_aux
statement:
theorem pRem_exists_aux (Q : Polynomial D) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (P : Polynomial D), P.natDegree < p →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
    (if P.natDegree < Q.natDegree then 0
     else P.natDegree - Q.natDegree + 1) ≤ n →
    ∃ A R : Polynomial D,
      Polynomial.C (Q.leadingCoeff ^ n) * P = A * Q + R ∧
      R.degree < Q.degree

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.quadratic_root_xi
statement:
theorem quadratic_root_xi (x : Fin p → L)
    (ij : Fin p × Fin p) :
    let P := ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
          (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
    P * Polynomial.C (x ij.1) ^ 2 -
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * P) * Polynomial.C (x ij.1) +
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) * P) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.quadratic_root_xj

theorem quadratic_root_xj (x : Fin p → L)

          (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
    P * Polynomial.C (x ij.2) ^ 2 -
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * P) * Polynomial.C (x ij.2) +
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) * P) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Proposition2_28.proposition_2_28_part2
statement:
theorem proposition_2_28_part2 (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P : R[X]) (_hP : P ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (σ σ' : ℕ → SignType) (hn : P.natDegree ≤ n)
    (x x' : R)
    (hx : x ∈ derReali P n σ) (hx' : x' ∈ derReali P n σ')
    (j : ℕ) (hj_le : j ≤ n)
    (hj_diff : σ j ≠ σ' j)
    (hj_agree : ∀ i, j < i → i ≤ n → σ i = σ' i) :
    j < n ∧
    σ (j + 1) = σ' (j + 1) ∧
    σ (j + 1) ≠ 0 ∧
    (σ (j + 1) = 1 → (x' < x ↔ σ' j < σ j)) ∧
    (σ (j + 1) = -1 → (x' < x ↔ σ j < σ' j))

name: Azurite.BPR.VirtualRoots.Internal.Interlaced.count_diff_le_one
statement:
lemma Interlaced.count_diff_le_one :
    ∀ {xs ys : List R}, Interlaced xs ys →
      ys.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) → ∀ (t : R),
        ys.count t ≤ xs.count t + 1 ∧ xs.count t ≤ ys.count t + 1
  | [_], [], _, _, _ => by
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    rw [List.count_cons]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | [], ys, h, _, _ => absurd h (by cases ys <;> simp [Interlaced])
  | [_], _ :: _, h, _, _ => absurd h (by simp [Interlaced])
  | _ :: _ :: _, [], h, _, _ => absurd h (by simp [Interlaced])
  | x :: x' :: xs, y :: ys, h, hsort, t => by
    obtain ⟨hxy, hyx', hrec⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.VirtualRoots.Internal.Interlaced.length_succ
statement:
lemma Interlaced.length_succ : ∀ {xs ys : List R}, Interlaced xs ys →
    xs.length = ys.length + 1
  | [_], [], _ => rfl
  | x :: x' :: xs, y :: ys, h => by
    obtain ⟨_, _, hrec⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.VirtualRoots.Internal.Interlaced.pairwise_of_ys
statement:
lemma Interlaced.pairwise_of_ys :
    ∀ {xs ys : List R}, Interlaced xs ys → ys.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) →
      xs.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)
  | [_], [], _, _ => by simp
  | x :: x' :: xs, [], h, _ => absurd h (by simp [Interlaced])
  | [x], _ :: _, h, _ => absurd h (by simp [Interlaced])
  | [], _, h, _ => absurd h (by cases ‹List R› <;> simp [Interlaced])
  | x :: x' :: xs, y :: ys, h, hys => by
    obtain ⟨hxy, hyx', hrec⟩

statement:
lemma exists_buildTail (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hdeg_pos : 0 < P.natDegree)
    (ys_full : List R)
    (hsorted_full : ys_full.Pairwise (· ≤ ·))
    (hsc_full : SignConstantOnGaps (derivative P) ys_full) :
    ∀ (ys_rest : List R) (past : List R) (v_prev : R),
      ys_full = past ++ v_prev :: ys_rest →
    ∃ (x_head : R) (xs_rest : List R),
      (x_head :: xs_rest).length = ys_rest.length + 1 ∧
      (x_head :: xs_rest).Pairwise (· ≤ ·) ∧
      v_prev ≤ x_head ∧
      Interlaced (x_head :: xs_rest) ys_rest ∧
      (∀ x y : R, v_prev ≤ x → x ≤ y →
        (∀ r ∈ x_head :: xs_rest, r < x ∨ y < r) →
        P.eval x ≠ 0 ∧ SignType.sign (P.eval x) = SignType.sign (P.eval y)) ∧
      ArgminPartitionFrom P v_prev (x_head :: xs_rest) ys_rest

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.lemma_2_36
statement:
theorem lemma_2_36 (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P : R[X]) {c d d' : R} (hdc : d < c) (hcd' : c < d')
    (hno_root : ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ x,
      x ∈ Set.Ico d c ∪ Set.Ioc c d' →
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0) :
    ((P.rootMultiplicity c : ℤ) ≤
        varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c) ∧
      Even (varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c) -
        P.rootMultiplicity c)) ∧
    varBetween (der P) (.finite c) (.finite d') = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.lemma_2_36_left
statement:
theorem lemma_2_36_left (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P : R[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) {c d : R} (hdc : d < c)
    (hno_root : ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico d c,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0) :
    ((P.rootMultiplicity c : ℤ) ≤
        varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c)) ∧
    Even (varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c) - P.rootMultiplicity c)

lemma varAt_cons_der_eq (P Q : R[X]) {c : R}
    (hPc : P.eval c ≠ 0) (hQ_ne : Q ≠ 0) :
    varAt (P :: der Q) (.finite c) =
      (if P.eval c * ((⇑derivative)^[Q.rootMultiplicity c] Q).eval c < 0
        then 1 else 0) + varAt (der Q) (.finite c)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.budan_fourier_finite
statement:
theorem budan_fourier_finite (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b : R} (hab : a < b) :
    ((numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite b) : ℤ) ≤
      varBetween (der P) (.finite a) (.finite b)) ∧
    Even (varBetween (der P) (.finite a) (.finite b) -
      (numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite b) : ℤ))

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.budan_fourier_negInf
statement:
theorem budan_fourier_negInf (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) (b : R) :
    ((numRoots P .negInf (.finite b) : ℤ) ≤
      varBetween (der P) .negInf (.finite b)) ∧
    Even (varBetween (der P) .negInf (.finite b) -
      (numRoots P .negInf (.finite b) : ℤ))

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.budan_fourier_negInf_posInf

theorem budan_fourier_negInf_posInf (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)

    Even (varBetween (der P) .negInf .posInf -
      (numRoots P .negInf .posInf : ℤ))

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.budan_fourier_posInf
statement:
theorem budan_fourier_posInf (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) (a : R) :
    ((numRoots P (.finite a) .posInf : ℤ) ≤

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.critPointsIoc_card_lt_of_lt_max
statement:
lemma critPointsIoc_card_lt_of_lt_max
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b d c : R} (hcb : c ≤ b) (hdc : d < c)

lemma critPointsIoc_subset_of_Ioc_subset

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.mem_critPointsIoc_iff
statement:
lemma mem_critPointsIoc_iff {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {r a b : R} :
    r ∈ critPointsIoc P a b ↔
    (a < r ∧ r ≤ b) ∧
      ∃ k ≤ P.natDegree, ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval r = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.no_iter_deriv_root_Ioc_of_max_critPointsIoc
statement:
lemma no_iter_deriv_root_Ioc_of_max_critPointsIoc
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b c : R}
    (hc : c ∈ critPointsIoc P a b)
    (hmax : ∀ r ∈ critPointsIoc P a b, r ≤ c) :
    ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioc c b, ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.no_iter_deriv_root_of_critPointsIoc_empty
statement:
lemma no_iter_deriv_root_of_critPointsIoc_empty
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b : R}
    (h : critPointsIoc P a b = ∅) :
    ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioc a b, ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.numRoots_Ioc_of_no_root
statement:
lemma numRoots_Ioc_of_no_root {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {d c : R} (hdc : d < c)
    (hno : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo d c, P.eval x ≠ 0) :
    numRoots P (.finite d) (.finite c) = P.rootMultiplicity c

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.numRoots_finite_finite
statement:
lemma numRoots_finite_finite (P : R[X]) (a b : R) :
    numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite b) =
      (P.roots.filter (fun r => a < r ∧ r ≤ b)).card

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.numRoots_split
statement:
lemma numRoots_split (P : R[X]) {a c b : R} (hac : a ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b) :
    numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite b) =
      numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite c) +
      numRoots P (.finite c) (.finite b)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.varBetween_and_numRoots_eq_zero_of_no_root_Ioc
statement:
lemma varBetween_and_numRoots_eq_zero_of_no_root_Ioc
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R) {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0)

    (hno : ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioc c b,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0) :
    varBetween (der P) (.finite c) (.finite b) = 0 ∧
    numRoots P (.finite c) (.finite b) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.varBetween_split
statement:
lemma varBetween_split (P : List R[X]) (a c b : ExtendedPoint R) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Lemma_2_48.jump_diff_formula
statement:
lemma jump_diff_formula {ν : ℕ} {a b : R} (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hsign : SignType.sign a = (-1)^ν * SignType.sign b) :
    ((if a < 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) - (if b < 0 then 1 else 0)) =
      if Even ν then 0 else if 0 < b then 1 else -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Lemma_2_48.lemma_2_48
statement:
theorem lemma_2_48 (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {d c : R} (hdc : d < c)
    (hno_root : ∀ k, k < P.natDegree → ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico d c,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0) :
    (virtualMultiplicity hIVP hP c : ℤ) =
      varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c)

name: Azurite.BPR.Lemma_2_48.varBetween_der_succ_of_not_root_at_c
statement:
lemma varBetween_der_succ_of_not_root_at_c
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hdP : derivative P ≠ 0) (hpos : 1 ≤ P.natDegree)
    {c d : R} (hdc : d < c) (hPc : P.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hno_root : ∀ k, k < P.natDegree → ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico d c,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0) :
    varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c) -
        varBetween (der (derivative P)) (.finite d) (.finite c) =
      (virtualMultiplicity hIVP hP c : ℤ) -
        ((virtualRoots hIVP hdP).count c : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Lemma_2_48.varBetween_der_succ_of_root_at_c_add_one
statement:
lemma varBetween_der_succ_of_root_at_c_add_one
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hpos : 1 ≤ P.natDegree)
    {c d : R} (hdc : d < c) (hPc : P.eval c = 0)
    (hno_root : ∀ k, k < P.natDegree → ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico d c,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval x ≠ 0) :
    varBetween (der P) (.finite d) (.finite c) =
      varBetween (der (derivative P)) (.finite d) (.finite c) + 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Lemma_2_48.corollary_2_49
statement:
theorem corollary_2_49
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) (c : R) :
    P.rootMultiplicity c ≤ virtualMultiplicity hIVP hP c ∧
      Even (virtualMultiplicity hIVP hP c - P.rootMultiplicity c)

theorem example_2_46_no_distinct_roots

theorem numRoots_eq_zero_of_var_eq_zero

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_35.unique_simple_root_of_var_eq_one
statement:
theorem unique_simple_root_of_var_eq_one
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R) {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b : R}

lemma SRemSList_head_decomp (P Q : K[X]) (n : ℕ) :

statement:
lemma SRemSList_succ (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Var_cons_cons_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma Var_cons_cons_of_ne_zero (a b : K) (L : List K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Var (a :: b :: L) = Var (b :: L) + (if a * b < 0 then 1 else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.lemma_2_59
statement:
theorem lemma_2_59
    (P Q : K[X]) (hQ_ne : Q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (a b : ExtendedPoint K)
    (haP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a ≠ 0)
    (haQ : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q a ≠ 0)
    (hbP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P b ≠ 0)
    (hbQ : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q b ≠ 0) :
    ((varAt (SRemSList P Q (n + 2)) a : ℤ) -
        (varAt (SRemSList P Q (n + 2)) b : ℤ)) =
      ((varAt (SRemSList Q (-(P % Q)) (n + 1)) a : ℤ) -
          (varAt (SRemSList Q (-(P % Q)) (n + 1)) b : ℤ)) +
        ((if ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a *
              ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q a < 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) -
          (if ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P b *
                ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q b < 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))

name: Azurite.BPR.lemma_2_59_pointwise
statement:
theorem lemma_2_59_pointwise
    (P Q : K[X]) (hQ_ne : Q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (x : ExtendedPoint K)
    (hP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P x ≠ 0)
    (hQ : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q x ≠ 0) :
    varAt (SRemSList P Q (n + 2)) x =
      varAt (SRemSList Q (-(P % Q)) (n + 1)) x +
        (if ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P x * ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q x < 0 then 1 else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.varAt_cons_cons_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma varAt_cons_cons_of_ne_zero
    (P Q : K[X]) (L : List K[X]) (a : ExtendedPoint K)
    (hP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a ≠ 0) (hQ : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q a ≠ 0) :
    varAt (P :: Q :: L) a =
      varAt (Q :: L) a +
        (if ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a * ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q a < 0 then 1 else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.cauchyIndexOn_eq_natDegree_extract
statement:
theorem cauchyIndexOn_eq_natDegree_extract
    (Q P : R[X]) (a b : ExtendedPoint R)
    (h : cauchyIndexOn Q P a b = (P.natDegree : ℤ)) :
    P.roots.toFinset.card = P.natDegree ∧
    Multiset.card P.roots = P.natDegree ∧
    P.roots.Nodup ∧
    (∀ r ∈ P.roots.toFinset, r ∈ ExtendedPoint.openInterval a b ∧
      JumpsFromNegInfToPosInf Q P r) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ P.roots.toFinset, ¬ JumpsFromPosInfToNegInf Q P r)

name: Azurite.BPR.remark_2_55_a
statement:
theorem remark_2_55_a
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (Q P : R[X]) (a b : ExtendedPoint R)
    (hP_pos : 0 < P.natDegree)
    (hQ_lt : Q.degree < P.degree) :
    cauchyIndexOn Q P a b = (P.natDegree : ℤ) ↔
      Q.natDegree + 1 = P.natDegree ∧
      SignType.sign P.leadingCoeff = SignType.sign Q.leadingCoeff ∧
      Multiset.card P.roots = P.natDegree ∧
      P.roots.Nodup ∧
      Multiset.card Q.roots = Q.natDegree ∧
      Q.roots.Nodup ∧
      (∀ r ∈ P.roots, r ∈ ExtendedPoint.openInterval a b) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Q.roots, s ∈ ExtendedPoint.openInterval a b) ∧
      Interlacing P Q

statement:
theorem remark_2_55_b
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)

statement:

name: Azurite.BPR.cauchyIndexOn_swap_sum
statement:
theorem cauchyIndexOn_swap_sum
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P Q : R[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (a b : ExtendedPoint R)
    (hab : ExtendedPoint.Lt a b)
    (ha : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a * ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q a ≠ 0)
    (hb : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P b * ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q b ≠ 0) :
    2 * (cauchyIndexOn Q P a b + cauchyIndexOn P Q a b) =
      sigmaPQ P Q b - sigmaPQ P Q a

name: Azurite.BPR.lemma_2_60
statement:
theorem lemma_2_60
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P Q : R[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (a b : ExtendedPoint R)
    (hab : ExtendedPoint.Lt a b)
    (ha : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a * ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q a ≠ 0)
    (hb : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P b * ExtendedPoint.evalPoly Q b ≠ 0) :
    2 * (cauchyIndexOn Q P a b - cauchyIndexOn (-(P % Q)) Q a b) =
      sigmaPQ P Q b - sigmaPQ P Q a

theorem tarskiQueryOn_eq_card_pos_sub_card_neg (Q P : R[X]) (a b : ExtendedPoint R) :

statement:
theorem var_eq_numRoots_of_all_roots_real
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R) {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0)

      (numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite b) : ℤ)

statement:
lemma SRemS_eval_opposite_sign_at_zero (P Q : R[X]) (a : R) (j : ℕ)
    (hP_eval : P.eval a ≠ 0)
    (h_curr_ne : SRemS P Q (j + 1) ≠ 0)
    (h_curr_eval_zero : (SRemS P Q (j + 1)).eval a = 0) :
    SRemS P Q j ≠ 0 ∧ (SRemS P Q j).eval a ≠ 0 ∧
      SRemS P Q (j + 2) ≠ 0 ∧ (SRemS P Q (j + 2)).eval a ≠ 0 ∧
      (SRemS P Q (j + 2)).eval a = -(SRemS P Q j).eval a

name: Azurite.BPR.theorem_2_58
statement:
theorem theorem_2_58
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P Q : R[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (a b : ExtendedPoint R)
    (hab : ExtendedPoint.Lt a b)
    (h_aP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a ≠ 0)
    (h_bP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P b ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : SRemS P Q n = 0) :
    ((varAt (SRemSList P Q n) a : ℤ) - (varAt (SRemSList P Q n) b : ℤ)) =
      cauchyIndexOn Q P a b

statement:
theorem theorem_2_58_no_SRemS_root_at_endpoints

    (hab : ExtendedPoint.Lt a b)
    (h_a : ∀ i : ℕ, SRemS P Q i = 0 ∨
        ExtendedPoint.evalPoly (SRemS P Q i) a ≠ 0)
    (h_b : ∀ i : ℕ, SRemS P Q i = 0 ∨
        ExtendedPoint.evalPoly (SRemS P Q i) b ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : SRemS P Q n = 0) :
    ((varAt (SRemSList P Q n) a : ℤ) - (varAt (SRemSList P Q n) b : ℤ)) =
      cauchyIndexOn Q P a b

name: Azurite.BPR.theorem_2_58_perturbation_exists
statement:
lemma theorem_2_58_perturbation_exists
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    (P Q : R[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (a b : ExtendedPoint R)
    (hab : ExtendedPoint.Lt a b)
    (h_aP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P a ≠ 0)
    (h_bP : ExtendedPoint.evalPoly P b ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : SRemS P Q n = 0) :
    ∃ a' b' : ExtendedPoint R,
      ExtendedPoint.Lt a' b' ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, SRemS P Q i = 0 ∨
        ExtendedPoint.evalPoly (SRemS P Q i) a' ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, SRemS P Q i = 0 ∨
        ExtendedPoint.evalPoly (SRemS P Q i) b' ≠ 0) ∧
      varAt (SRemSList P Q n) a = varAt (SRemSList P Q n) a' ∧
      varAt (SRemSList P Q n) b = varAt (SRemSList P Q n) b' ∧
      cauchyIndexOn Q P a b = cauchyIndexOn Q P a' b'

statement:
theorem theorem_2_61
    (hIVP : Azurite.BPR.HasIntermediateValueProperty R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem_2_47.numVirtualRoots_eq_virtualMultiplicity_of_no_iter_deriv_root_Ioo
statement:
lemma numVirtualRoots_eq_virtualMultiplicity_of_no_iter_deriv_root_Ioo
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R) {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    {d c : R} (hdc : d < c)
    (hno : ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo d c,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval y ≠ 0) :
    numVirtualRoots hIVP hP d c = virtualMultiplicity hIVP hP c

statement:
lemma numVirtualRoots_eq_zero_of_no_iter_deriv_root_Ioc
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R) {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    {a b : R}
    (hno : ∀ k ≤ P.natDegree, ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioc a b,
      ((⇑derivative)^[k] P).eval y ≠ 0) :
    numVirtualRoots hIVP hP a b = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem_2_47.numVirtualRoots_split
statement:
lemma numVirtualRoots_split (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a c b : R} (hac : a ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b) :
    numVirtualRoots hIVP hP a b =
      numVirtualRoots hIVP hP a c + numVirtualRoots hIVP hP c b

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem_2_47.theorem_2_47_finite
statement:
theorem theorem_2_47_finite (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b : R} (hab : a < b) :
    (numVirtualRoots hIVP hP a b : ℤ) =
      varBetween (der P) (.finite a) (.finite b)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem_2_47.varBetween_sub_numRoots_eq_sum_multiplicity_gap
statement:
theorem varBetween_sub_numRoots_eq_sum_multiplicity_gap
    (hIVP : HasIntermediateValueProperty R)
    {P : R[X]} (hP : P ≠ 0) {a b : R} (hab : a < b) :
    varBetween (der P) (.finite a) (.finite b) -
        (numRoots P (.finite a) (.finite b) : ℤ) =
      ((virtualRoots hIVP hP).toFinset.filter (fun x => a < x ∧ x ≤ b)).sum
        (fun r => (virtualMultiplicity hIVP hP r : ℤ) -
                  (P.rootMultiplicity r : ℤ))

theorem mem_realizationOver {σ : SignCondition ι} {P : R[X]} {Q : ι → R[X]} {x : R} :

      P.eval x = 0 ∧ ∀ i, SignType.sign ((Q i).eval x) = σ i

    (hx : x ∈ σ.realizationOver P Q) (hy : y ∈ σ.realizationOver P Q) :

theorem sign_familyPow_eval_eq_signPow (σ : SignCondition ι) (P : R[X])

statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixOfSigns_apply (A : List (ι → ℕ)) (S : List (SignCondition ι))

statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixTensor_apply (M : Matrix l m α) (M' : Matrix n p α)
    (i : l × n) (j : m × p) :
    (M ⊗ₘ M') i j = M i.1 j.1 * M' i.2 j.2

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_2_64
statement:
theorem proposition_2_64 (P Q : R[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hndisjoint : ∀ x : R, P.IsRoot x → Q.eval x ≠ 0) :
    ((P.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => 0 < Q.eval x)).card : ℤ)
        = (tarskiQuery 1 P + tarskiQuery Q P) / 2 ∧
    ((P.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => Q.eval x < 0)).card : ℤ)
        = (tarskiQuery 1 P - tarskiQuery Q P) / 2

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_2_65
statement:
theorem proposition_2_65 (P Q : R[X]) :
    ((P.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => Q.eval x = 0)).card : ℤ)
        = tarskiQuery 1 P - tarskiQuery (Q ^ 2) P ∧
    ((P.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => 0 < Q.eval x)).card : ℤ)
        = (tarskiQuery (Q ^ 2) P + tarskiQuery Q P) / 2 ∧
    ((P.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => Q.eval x < 0)).card : ℤ)
        = (tarskiQuery (Q ^ 2) P - tarskiQuery Q P) / 2

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_2_68
statement:
theorem proposition_2_68 (P : R[X]) (Q : ι → R[X]) (A : List (ι → ℕ))
    (S : List (SignCondition ι)) (hS : S.Nodup)
    (hcover : ∀ x, P.IsRoot x → (fun i => SignType.sign ((Q i).eval x)) ∈ S) :
    Matrix.mulVec (fun i j => ((matrixOfSigns A S i j : SignType) : ℤ))
        (fun j => (((S.get j).realizationOverFinset P Q).card : ℤ))
      = fun i => tarskiQuery (familyPow Q (A.get i)) P

name: Azurite.BPR.tarskiQuery_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem tarskiQuery_eq_sum_roots (Q' P : R[X]) :
    tarskiQuery Q' P = ∑ x ∈ P.roots.toFinset, (SignType.sign (Q'.eval x) : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.tarskiQuery_familyPow_eq_sum
statement:
theorem tarskiQuery_familyPow_eq_sum (P : R[X]) (Q : ι → R[X]) (α : ι → ℕ)
    (T : Finset (SignCondition ι))
    (hcover : ∀ x, P.IsRoot x → (fun i => SignType.sign ((Q i).eval x)) ∈ T) :
    tarskiQuery (familyPow Q α) P =
      ∑ σ ∈ T, (σ.pow α : ℤ) * ((σ.realizationOverFinset P Q).card : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.proposition_2_68_single
statement:
theorem proposition_2_68_single (P Q : R[X]) :
    (!![(1 : ℤ), 1, 1; 0, 1, -1; 0, 1, 1]) *ᵥ
        ![ ((SignCondition.realizationOverFinset ![0] P (fun _ => Q)).card : ℤ),
           ((SignCondition.realizationOverFinset ![1] P (fun _ => Q)).card : ℤ),

name: Azurite.BPR.isChain_zip_tail_of_colChain
statement:
theorem isChain_zip_tail_of_colChain {S : Finset ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℚ} :
    ∀ M : List (ℕ × ℚ), (∀ V ∈ M, V.2 = f V.1 ∧ V.1 ∈ S) →
      M.IsChain (fun A B => ∀ i ∈ S, OnOrAbove A B (i, f i)) →
      (M.zip M.tail).IsChain (fun e₁ e₂ : (ℕ × ℚ) × (ℕ × ℚ) => OnOrAbove e₁.1 e₁.2 e₂.2)
  | [], _, _ => List.isChain_nil
  | [_], _, _ => List.isChain_nil
  | a :: b :: l, hcol, hch => by
      have hchbl : (b :: l).IsChain (fun A B => ∀ i ∈ S, OnOrAbove A B (i, f i)) :=
        (List.isChain_cons.mp hch).2
      have hcolbl : ∀ V ∈ (b :: l), V.2 = f V.1 ∧ V.1 ∈ S :=
        fun V hV => hcol V (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hV)
      have ih := isChain_zip_tail_of_colChain (b :: l) hcolbl hchbl
      have habrel : ∀ i ∈ S, OnOrAbove a b (i, f i) := by
        have h := (List.isChain_cons.mp hch).1
        rw [List.head?_cons] at h
        exact h b rfl
      rw [show (a :: b :: l).zip (a :: b :: l).tail = (a, b) :: (b :: l).zip (b :: l).tail from by
        rw [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.tail_cons], List.isChain_cons]
      refine ⟨fun e he => ?_, ih⟩
      cases l with
      | nil => simp at he
      | cons c l' =>
          rw [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at he
          subst he
          obtain ⟨hc2, hc1⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.lower_hull_exists
statement:
theorem lower_hull_exists (S : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ) (N : ℕ)
    (hSN : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≤ N) (hNS : N ∈ S) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ a : ℕ, a ∈ S → N - a ≤ d → ∀ s : ℚ,
      (∀ i ∈ S, f a + s * ((i : ℚ) - a) ≤ f i) →
      ∃ M : List (ℕ × ℚ), M.head? = some (a, f a) ∧ M.getLast? = some (N, f N)
        ∧ (∀ V ∈ M, V.2 = f V.1 ∧ V.1 ∈ S)
        ∧ M.IsChain (fun A B => A.1 < B.1)
        ∧ M.IsChain (fun A B : ℕ × ℚ => ∀ i ∈ S, OnOrAbove A B (i, f i))

name: Azurite.BPR.lower_hull_exists_strict
statement:
theorem lower_hull_exists_strict (S : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ) (N : ℕ)
    (hSN : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≤ N) (hNS : N ∈ S) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ a : ℕ, a ∈ S → N - a ≤ d → ∀ s : ℚ,
      (∀ i ∈ S, f a + s * ((i : ℚ) - a) ≤ f i) →
      (∀ i ∈ S, a < i → f a + s * ((i : ℚ) - a) < f i) →
      ∃ M : List (ℕ × ℚ), M.head? = some (a, f a) ∧ M.getLast? = some (N, f N)
        ∧ (∀ V ∈ M, V.2 = f V.1 ∧ V.1 ∈ S)
        ∧ M.IsChain (fun A B => A.1 < B.1)
        ∧ M.IsChain (fun A B : ℕ × ℚ => ∀ i ∈ S, OnOrAbove A B (i, f i))
        ∧ (∀ U V : ℕ × ℚ, (U, V) ∈ M.zip M.tail →
            ∀ h ∈ S, (f h : ℚ) = lineValue U V h → U.1 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ V.1)
