name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.count_diag_map
statement:
lemma count_diag_map {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (a : α) :
    (s.map (fun y => ((y, y) : α × α))).count (a, a) = s.count a

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.count_product_eq
statement:
lemma count_product_eq {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (s : Multiset α) (t : Multiset β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    (s ×ˢ t).count (a, b) = s.count a * t.count b

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem disc_eq_zero_iff (P : K[X]) (hP : P.Monic) :
    (disc P : C) = 0 ↔ 0 < (EuclideanDomain.gcd P P.derivative).natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff (P : K[X]) :
    (((P.aroots C ×ˢ P.aroots C - (P.aroots C).map (fun a => (a, a))).map
        (fun ab : C × C => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod = 0)
      ↔ ¬(P.aroots C).Nodup

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.discR_aux_eq_sq
statement:
lemma discR_aux_eq_sq (s : Multiset R) (hs : s.Nodup) :
    (-1 : R) ^ (s.card * (s.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((s ×ˢ s - s.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod =
    ((((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun ab : R × R => ab.1 > ab.2)).map
      (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod) ^ 2

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.discR_pos_of_distinct_roots
statement:
theorem discR_pos_of_distinct_roots (P : R[X]) (_hP : P.Monic)
    (hnodup : P.roots.Nodup) :
    0 < discR P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_eq_algebraMap_discR
statement:
theorem disc_eq_algebraMap_discR (P : R[X]) (hsplits : P.Splits) :
    (disc P : C) = (algebraMap R C) (discR P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_pos_of_real_distinct_roots
statement:
theorem disc_pos_of_real_distinct_roots (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (hsplits : P.Splits) (hnodup : P.roots.Nodup) :
    ∃ d : R, 0 < d ∧ (algebraMap R C) d = (disc P : C)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.filter_gt_prod_ne_zero
statement:
lemma filter_gt_prod_ne_zero (s : Multiset R) (_hs : s.Nodup) :
    (((s ×ˢ s).filter (fun ab : R × R => ab.1 > ab.2)).map
      (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.multiset_map_sub_of_injective
statement:
lemma multiset_map_sub_of_injective {α β : Type*}
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (m n : Multiset α) :
    (m - n).map f = m.map f - n.map f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.multiset_product_map
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.algebraMap_discReal_eq_disc
statement:
theorem algebraMap_discReal_eq_disc (P : R[X]) :
    algebraMap R (Ri R) (discReal P) = (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_conj_invariant
statement:
theorem disc_conj_invariant (P : R[X]) :
    (Ri.conj R) (disc P : Ri R) = (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.disc_mem_range_algebraMap
statement:
theorem disc_mem_range_algebraMap (P : R[X]) :
    ∃ d : R, algebraMap R (Ri R) d = (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_vandermonde_of_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_vandermonde_of_factorization (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    ∃ V : Ri R,
      V ^ 2 = (disc P : Ri R) ∧
      (Ri.conj R) V = (-1) ^ quadratics.card * V ∧
      V ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.natDegree_eq_of_factorization
statement:
lemma natDegree_eq_of_factorization
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (P : R[X])
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod) :
    P.natDegree = linears.card + 2 * quadratics.card

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.offdiag_prod_eq_omega_sq
statement:
theorem offdiag_prod_eq_omega_sq (P : R[X])
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    ((((P.aroots (Ri R)) ×ˢ (P.aroots (Ri R)) -
        (P.aroots (Ri R)).map (fun a => (a, a))).map
        (fun ab : Ri R × Ri R => ab.1 - ab.2))).prod =
      algebraMap R (Ri R)
        ((-1) ^ (linears.card * (linears.card - 1) / 2) *
          (vandermondeOmega linears quadratics) ^ 2)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_5
statement:
theorem proposition_4_5 (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    (0 < discReal P ↔ P.roots.card ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4]) ∧
    (discReal P < 0 ↔ P.roots.card + 2 ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4])

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_5_of_factorization
statement:
theorem proposition_4_5_of_factorization (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    (0 < discReal P ↔ linears.card ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4]) ∧
    (discReal P < 0 ↔ linears.card + 2 ≡ P.natDegree [MOD 4])

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_discReal_of_factorization
statement:
theorem sign_discReal_of_factorization (P : R[X]) (hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    (0 < discReal P ↔ Even quadratics.card) ∧
    (discReal P < 0 ↔ Odd quadratics.card)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.vandermondeOmega_ne_zero
statement:
theorem vandermondeOmega_ne_zero (P : R[X]) (_hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    vandermondeOmega linears quadratics ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.vandermondeOmega_sq_eq
statement:
theorem vandermondeOmega_sq_eq (P : R[X]) (_hP : P.Monic)
    (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R))
    (hq_ne : ∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0)
    (hfact : P = (linears.map (Factorization.linearFactor (R := R))).prod *
                  (quadratics.map (Factorization.quadraticFactor (R := R))).prod)
    (hnodup : (P.aroots (Ri R)).Nodup) :
    algebraMap R (Ri R) ((vandermondeOmega linears quadratics) ^ 2) =
      (-1) ^ quadratics.card * (disc P : Ri R)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.newtonSum_zero
statement:
lemma newtonSum_zero (P : K[X]) :
    (newtonSum P 0 : C) = ((P.aroots C).card : C)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_8_series
statement:
theorem proposition_4_8_series (P : K[X]) (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) (N : ℕ) :
    ((Polynomial.X : C[X])^N * (P.map (algebraMap K C)).derivative -
     (P.map (algebraMap K C)) *
       (Finset.range N).sum (fun i =>
         Polynomial.C (newtonSum P i) * (Polynomial.X : C[X])^(N - 1 - i))
    ).natDegree < P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDisc_card_pred_eq
statement:
lemma sDisc_card_pred_eq (P : K[X]) (h : 0 < (P.aroots C).card) :
    (sDisc P ((P.aroots C).card - 1) : C) = ((P.aroots C).card : C)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDisc_zero_eq_disc
statement:
lemma sDisc_zero_eq_disc (P : K[X]) (hMonic : P.Monic) :
    (sDisc P 0 : C) = disc P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_nodup_mem_powersetCard_iff
statement:
lemma exists_nodup_mem_powersetCard_iff (s : Multiset R) (k : ℕ) :
    (∃ t ∈ s.powersetCard k, t.Nodup) ↔ k ≤ s.toFinset.card

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff_not_nodup
statement:
lemma offdiag_prod_eq_zero_iff_not_nodup (t : Multiset R) :
    ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod = 0
      ↔ ¬ t.Nodup

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDiscR_eq_sum_signed
statement:
lemma sDiscR_eq_sum_signed (P : R[X]) (j : ℕ) :
    sDiscR P j =
      ((P.roots.powersetCard (P.roots.card - j)).map (fun t : Multiset R =>
        (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
        ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod)).sum

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDiscR_first_nonzero_iff
statement:
theorem sDiscR_first_nonzero_iff (P : R[X]) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ P.roots.card) :
    ((∀ i < j, sDiscR P i = 0) ∧ sDiscR P j ≠ 0)
      ↔ P.roots.toFinset.card = P.roots.card - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sDiscR_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sDiscR_ne_zero_iff (P : R[X]) (j : ℕ) :
    sDiscR P j ≠ 0 ↔ P.roots.card - j ≤ P.roots.toFinset.card

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_smul_offdiag_prod_eq_zero_of_not_nodup
statement:
lemma sign_smul_offdiag_prod_eq_zero_of_not_nodup (t : Multiset R) (ht : ¬ t.Nodup) :
    (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_smul_offdiag_prod_nonneg
statement:
lemma sign_smul_offdiag_prod_nonneg (t : Multiset R) :
    0 ≤ (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_smul_offdiag_prod_pos_of_nodup
statement:
lemma sign_smul_offdiag_prod_pos_of_nodup (t : Multiset R) (ht : t.Nodup) :
    0 < (-1 : R) ^ (t.card * (t.card - 1) / 2) *
      ((t ×ˢ t - t.map (fun a => (a, a))).map (fun ab => ab.1 - ab.2)).prod

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_9
statement:
theorem proposition_4_9 (P : K[X]) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ (P.aroots C).card) :
    (sDisc P ((P.aroots C).card - k) : C) =
      algebraMap K C P.leadingCoeff ^ (2 * k - 2) *
        (newtMat P k : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) C).det

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem Res_eq_zero_iff (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    Res P Q = 0 ↔
      ∃ U V : D[X], U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
        U.natDegree < Q.natDegree ∧ V.natDegree < P.natDegree ∧
        U * P + V * Q = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.encodeU_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem Syl.encodeU_natDegree_lt (p q : ℕ) (uv : Fin (p + q) → D) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (Syl.encodeU p q uv).natDegree < q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.encodeV_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem Syl.encodeV_natDegree_lt (p q : ℕ) (uv : Fin (p + q) → D) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (Syl.encodeV p q uv).natDegree < p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.encode_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem Syl.encode_eq_zero_iff (p q : ℕ) (uv : Fin (p + q) → D) :
    (Syl.encodeU p q uv = 0 ∧ Syl.encodeV p q uv = 0) ↔ uv = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.mulMap_eq_pair
statement:
theorem Syl.mulMap_eq_pair (P Q : D[X])
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree) → D) :
    Syl.mulMap P Q uv =
      Syl.encodeU P.natDegree Q.natDegree uv * P +
      Syl.encodeV P.natDegree Q.natDegree uv * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Syl.mulMap_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem Syl.mulMap_natDegree_lt (P Q : D[X])
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree) → D)
    (hpq : 0 < P.natDegree + Q.natDegree) :
    (Syl.mulMap P Q uv).natDegree < P.natDegree + Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_resultant
statement:
theorem Res_eq_resultant (P Q : D[X]) :
    Res P Q = Polynomial.resultant P Q P.natDegree Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lemma_4_18_Res
statement:
theorem Lemma_4_18_Res (P Q C R : D[X])
    (h_C : C.natDegree + Q.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_R : R.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_decomp : P = C * Q + R) :
    Res P Q =
      (-1) ^ (P.natDegree * Q.natDegree) *
        Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - R.natDegree) * Res Q R

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lemma_4_18_Theta
statement:
theorem Lemma_4_18_Theta (P Q C R : K[X])
    (h_C : C.natDegree + Q.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_R : R.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree)
    (h_P_splits : P.Splits) (h_Q_splits : Q.Splits)
    (h_decomp : P = C * Q + R) :
    Θ P Q Q.natDegree =
      (-1) ^ (P.natDegree * Q.natDegree) *
        Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - R.natDegree) * Θ Q R R.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Θ_eq_resultant
statement:
theorem Θ_eq_resultant (P Q : K[X]) (q : ℕ) (hP : P.Splits)
    (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ q) :
    Θ P Q q = Polynomial.resultant P Q P.natDegree q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lemma_4_24
statement:
theorem Lemma_4_24 (P Q : D[X]) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j < P.natDegree)
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    sRes P Q j = 0 ↔
      ∃ U V : D[X], U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
        U.degree < ↑(Q.natDegree - j) ∧
        V.degree < ↑(P.natDegree - j) ∧
        (U * P + V * Q).degree < ↑j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.encodeU_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem SyHa.encodeU_natDegree_lt (p q j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ q) (hj_p : j ≤ p)
    (uv : Fin (p + q - 2 * j) → D) (hqj : 0 < q - j) :
    (SyHa.encodeU p q j hj_q hj_p uv).natDegree < q - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.encodeV_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem SyHa.encodeV_natDegree_lt (p q j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ q) (hj_p : j ≤ p)
    (uv : Fin (p + q - 2 * j) → D) (hpj : 0 < p - j) :
    (SyHa.encodeV p q j hj_q hj_p uv).natDegree < p - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.encode_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem SyHa.encode_eq_zero_iff (p q j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ q) (hj_p : j ≤ p)
    (uv : Fin (p + q - 2 * j) → D) :
    (SyHa.encodeU p q j hj_q hj_p uv = 0 ∧
      SyHa.encodeV p q j hj_q hj_p uv = 0) ↔ uv = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.mulMap_eq_pair
statement:
theorem SyHa.mulMap_eq_pair (P Q : D[X]) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j ≤ P.natDegree)
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - 2 * j) → D) :
    SyHa.mulMap P Q j uv =
      SyHa.encodeU P.natDegree Q.natDegree j hj_q hj_p uv * P +
      SyHa.encodeV P.natDegree Q.natDegree j hj_q hj_p uv * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.SyHa.mulMap_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem SyHa.mulMap_natDegree_lt (P Q : D[X]) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j ≤ P.natDegree)
    (uv : Fin (P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - 2 * j) → D)
    (hpq : 0 < P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - 2 * j) :
    (SyHa.mulMap P Q j uv).natDegree <
      P.natDegree + Q.natDegree - j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.blockReversePerm_apply_val
statement:
theorem blockReversePerm_apply_val (p q : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + q)) :
    (blockReversePerm p q i).val =
      if i.val < q then i.val else p + 2 * q - 1 - i.val

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes_zero_eq_eps_mul_Res
statement:
theorem sRes_zero_eq_eps_mul_Res (P Q : D[X]) :
    sRes P Q 0 = ε P.natDegree * Res P Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_blockReversePerm
statement:
theorem sign_blockReversePerm (p q : ℕ) :
    ((Equiv.Perm.sign (blockReversePerm p q)) : ℤ) = ε p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_revPerm
statement:
theorem sign_revPerm (n : ℕ) :
    ((Equiv.Perm.sign (Fin.revPerm : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))) : ℤ) = ε n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_add_two
statement: theorem ε_add_two (n : ℕ) : ε (n + 2) = -ε n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul
statement: theorem ε_four_mul (i : ℕ) : ε (4 * i) = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul_sub_one
statement: theorem ε_four_mul_sub_one (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) : ε (4 * i - 1) = -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul_sub_three
statement: theorem ε_four_mul_sub_three (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) : ε (4 * i - 3) = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_four_mul_sub_two
statement: theorem ε_four_mul_sub_two (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) : ε (4 * i - 2) = -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ε_one : ε 1 = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_sub_two_mul
statement:
theorem ε_sub_two_mul (i j : ℕ) (h : 2 * j ≤ i) :
    ε (i - 2 * j) = (-1) ^ j * ε i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ε_zero : ε 0 = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_cons_cons_ne
statement:
theorem PmV_cons_cons_ne (sp sq : K) (tl : List K) (hsq : sq ≠ 0) :
    PmV (sp :: sq :: tl) = PmV (sq :: tl) + (SignType.sign (sp * sq) : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_eq_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem PmV_eq_of_forall_ne_zero :
    ∀ (s : List K), s ≠ [] → (∀ x ∈ s, x ≠ 0) →
      PmV s + 2 * (Var s : ℤ) = (s.length : ℤ) - 1
  | [], hs, _ => absurd rfl hs
  | [_], _, h0 => by simp [Var_of_forall_ne_zero h0]
  | sp :: sq :: tl, _, h0 => by
    have hsp : sp ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_eq_varBetween
statement:
theorem PmV_eq_varBetween (P : List K[X]) (hne : ∀ Q ∈ P, Q ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : P.IsChain (fun Q Q' => Q.natDegree = Q'.natDegree + 1)) :
    (PmV (P.map Polynomial.leadingCoeff) : ℤ)
      = varBetween P ExtendedPoint.negInf ExtendedPoint.posInf

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem PmV_nil : PmV ([] : List K) = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem PmV_singleton (a : K) : PmV [a] = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sResSeq_getElem
statement:
theorem sResSeq_getElem (P Q : D[X]) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < P.natDegree + 1) :
    (sResSeq P Q)[k]'(by simpa using hk) = sRes P Q (P.natDegree - k)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sResSeq_head?
statement:
theorem sResSeq_head? (P Q : D[X]) :
    (sResSeq P Q).head? = some (sRes P Q P.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sResSeq_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem sResSeq_length (P Q : D[X]) :
    (sResSeq P Q).length = P.natDegree + 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.eps_qj
statement:
theorem eps_qj (p q j : ℕ) (hqp : q ≤ p) (hjq : j ≤ q) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (q - j) * ε (p + q - 2 * j) = ε (p - q)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_37_part1
statement:
theorem proposition_4_37_part1 (P Q : K[X]) (j : ℕ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hjr : j ≤ (P % Q).natDegree) (hrq : (P % Q).natDegree < Q.natDegree)
    (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sRes P Q j = ((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K) *
      Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - (P % Q).natDegree) * sRes Q (-(P % Q)) j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_37_part2
statement:
theorem proposition_4_37_part2 (P Q : K[X]) (j : ℕ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hr : (P % Q).natDegree < j) (hjq : j < Q.natDegree)
    (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sRes P Q j = 0 ∧ sRes Q (-(P % Q)) j = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_mul_self
statement: theorem ε_mul_self (n : ℕ) : ε n * ε n = 1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_cons_zeros
statement:
theorem PmV_cons_zeros (a : K) (zeros : List K) (hz : ∀ x ∈ zeros, x = 0)
    (b : K) (hb : b ≠ 0) (rest : List K) :
    PmV (a :: (zeros ++ b :: rest)) = PmV (b :: rest) +
      (if Odd (zeros.length + 1) then
        ε (zeros.length + 1) * (SignType.sign (a * b) : ℤ) else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.PmV_smul
statement:
theorem PmV_smul {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∀ l : List K, PmV (l.map (fun x => c * x)) = PmV l
  | [] => by simp
  | sp :: rest => by
    have hpred : (fun x : K => decide (c * x = 0)) = (fun x => decide (x = 0))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.eps_cast_ne
statement: theorem eps_cast_ne (n : ℕ) : ((ε n : ℤ) : K) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_36
statement:
theorem lemma_4_36 (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR : P % Q ≠ 0)
    (hrq : (P % Q).natDegree < Q.natDegree) (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    PmV (sResSeq P Q) = PmV (sResSeq Q (-(P % Q)))
      + (if Odd (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree)
          then (SignType.sign (P.leadingCoeff * Q.leadingCoeff) : ℤ) else 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes_eq_zero_of_gap
statement:
theorem sRes_eq_zero_of_gap (P Q : K[X]) {j : ℕ} (hqj : Q.natDegree < j)
    (hjp : j < P.natDegree) : sRes P Q j = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sRes_q_eq
statement:
theorem sRes_q_eq (P Q : K[X]) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hqp : Q.natDegree < P.natDegree) :
    sRes P Q Q.natDegree = ((ε (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree) : ℤ) : K) *
      Q.leadingCoeff ^ (P.natDegree - Q.natDegree)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_eps
statement: theorem sign_eps (n : ℕ) : (SignType.sign ((ε n : ℤ) : K) : ℤ) = ε n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_pow_cast
statement:
theorem sign_pow_cast (x : K) (m : ℕ) :
    (SignType.sign (x ^ m) : ℤ) = (SignType.sign x : ℤ) ^ m

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sign_pow_odd
statement:
theorem sign_pow_odd (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) :
    (SignType.sign (x ^ m) : ℤ) = (SignType.sign x : ℤ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.ε_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement: theorem ε_eq_one_or_neg_one (n : ℕ) : ε n = 1 ∨ ε n = -1

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_zero_iff_not_isCoprime
statement:
theorem Res_eq_zero_iff_not_isCoprime (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    Res P Q = 0 ↔
      ¬ IsCoprime (P.map (algebraMap D K)) (Q.map (algebraMap D K))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_map
statement:
theorem Res_map {E : Type*} [CommRing E] (f : D →+* E)
    (P Q : D[X])
    (hPdeg : (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hQdeg : (Q.map f).natDegree = Q.natDegree) :
    f (Res P Q) = Res (P.map f) (Q.map f)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lcm_natDegree_eq
statement:
theorem lcm_natDegree_eq (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    (lcm P Q).natDegree + (gcd P Q).natDegree =
      P.natDegree + Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_19
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_19 (P Q : D[X])
    (H : P.natDegree ≠ 0 ∨ Q.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U V : D[X], U.degree < Q.natDegree ∧ V.degree < P.natDegree ∧
      C (Res P Q) = U * P + V * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_21
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_21 (P Q : D[X]) (f : D →+* D')
    (hPdeg : (P.map f).natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hQdeg : (Q.map f).natDegree = Q.natDegree) :
    f (Res P Q) = Res (P.map f) (Q.map f)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_25
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_25 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j < P.natDegree) :
    (∀ i, i < j → sRes P Q i = 0) ↔ (gcd P Q).natDegree ≥ j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_UV_zero_iff_gcd_natDegree_ge
statement:
theorem exists_UV_zero_iff_gcd_natDegree_ge
    (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j ≤ P.natDegree) :
    (∃ U V : K[X], U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
      U.natDegree ≤ Q.natDegree - j ∧
      V.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree - j ∧
      U * P + V * Q = 0) ↔
        (gcd P Q).natDegree ≥ j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_26
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_26 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hj_q : j ≤ Q.natDegree) (hj_p : j < P.natDegree) :
    (gcd P Q).natDegree = j ↔
      (∀ i, i < j → sRes P Q i = 0) ∧ sRes P Q j ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_28
statement:
theorem proposition_4_28 (P : K[X]) (hP : 0 < P.natDegree) (k : ℕ)
    (hk_pos : 0 < k) (hk_le : k ≤ P.natDegree) :
    (algebraMap K C) P.leadingCoeff *
        sDisc P (P.natDegree - k) =
      (algebraMap K C) (sRes P P.derivative (P.natDegree - k))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Proposition_4_30
statement:
theorem Proposition_4_30 (P : K[X]) (hP : 0 < P.natDegree)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < P.natDegree) :
    (gcd P P.derivative).natDegree = j ↔
      (∀ i, i < j → (sDisc P i : C) = 0) ∧ (sDisc P j : C) ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.leadingCoeff_pow_mul_Res_eq
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_pow_mul_Res_eq {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] (P Q : D[X])
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (hpq : P.natDegree = Q.natDegree) :
    P.leadingCoeff ^ (C P.leadingCoeff * Q - C Q.leadingCoeff * P).natDegree * Res P Q
      = Res P (C P.leadingCoeff * Q - C Q.leadingCoeff * P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Res_eq_Θ_of_splits
statement:
theorem Res_eq_Θ_of_splits (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P.Splits) :
    Res P Q = Θ P Q Q.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_17
statement:
theorem Theorem_4_17 (P Q : K[X]) (hP : P.Splits) (hQ : Q.Splits) :
    Res P Q =
      P.leadingCoeff ^ Q.natDegree * Q.leadingCoeff ^ P.natDegree *
        ((P.roots ×ˢ Q.roots).map fun pr => pr.1 - pr.2).prod

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.corollary_4_40
statement:
theorem corollary_4_40 (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (hM : M.IsSymm) :
    ∃ (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (D : Fin n → K),
      IsUnit B.det ∧ M = B * Matrix.diagonal D * B.transpose ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => 0 < D i)).card = sigPos (quadraticForm M) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => D i < 0)).card = sigNeg (quadraticForm M)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.quadraticFormRank_eq_sigPos_add_sigNeg
statement:
theorem quadraticFormRank_eq_sigPos_add_sigNeg
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) (hM : M.IsSymm) :
    quadraticFormRank M = sigPos (quadraticForm M) + sigNeg (quadraticForm M)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.HerMatrix_mem_range
statement:
theorem HerMatrix_mem_range (P Q : D[X]) (hP : P.Monic) (i j : Fin P.natDegree) :
    HerMatrix P Q i j ∈ (algebraMap D C).range

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.HerMatrix_one_eq_newtMat
statement:
theorem HerMatrix_one_eq_newtMat (P : K[X]) :
    (HerMatrix P 1 : Matrix (Fin P.natDegree) (Fin P.natDegree) C) = newtMat P P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Her_apply
statement:
theorem Her_apply (P Q : D[X]) (f : Fin P.natDegree → C) :
    Her P Q f = ∑ i : Fin P.natDegree, ∑ j : Fin P.natDegree, HerMatrix P Q i j * f i * f j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Her_eq_matrix
statement:
theorem Her_eq_matrix (P Q : D[X]) (f : Fin P.natDegree → C) :
    Her P Q f = f ⬝ᵥ HerMatrix P Q *ᵥ f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Her_one_apply
statement:
theorem Her_one_apply (P : K[X]) (f : Fin P.natDegree → C) :
    Her P 1 f = ∑ i : Fin P.natDegree, ∑ j : Fin P.natDegree,
      newtonSum P ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) * f i * f j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_41
statement:
theorem proposition_4_41 (v : Fin n → (Fin n → R)) (hv : LinearIndependent R v) :
    ∃ w : Fin n → (Fin n → R),
      LinearIndependent R w ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsOrthogonal (w i) (w j)) ∧
      (∀ i, w i - v i ∈ Submodule.span R (v '' {j | j < i})) ∧
      (∀ i, w i - v i ∈ Submodule.span R (w '' {j | j < i}))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_42
statement:
theorem proposition_4_42 (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hM : M.IsSymm)
    (hpos : IsNonNeg M) (f g : Fin n → R) :
    bilinFormM M f g ^ 2 ≤ quadraticForm M f * quadraticForm M g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lmul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem Lmul_apply (P : K[X]) (f g : AdjoinRoot P) : Lmul P f g = f * g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Lmul_mk
statement:
theorem Lmul_mk (P a b : K[X]) :
    Lmul P (AdjoinRoot.mk P a) (AdjoinRoot.mk P b) = AdjoinRoot.mk P ((a * b) %ₘ P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Tr_eq_matrix_trace
statement:
theorem Tr_eq_matrix_trace {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (P : K[X])
    (b : Module.Basis ι K (AdjoinRoot P)) (f : AdjoinRoot P →ₗ[K] AdjoinRoot P) :
    Tr P f = ((LinearMap.toMatrix b b) f).trace

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.adjoinRoot_powerBasis_apply
statement:
theorem adjoinRoot_powerBasis_apply (P : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hP).dim) :
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hP).basis i = AdjoinRoot.root P ^ (i : ℕ)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.finrank_adjoinRoot
statement:
theorem finrank_adjoinRoot (P : K[X]) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank K (AdjoinRoot P) = P.natDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff (P f g : K[X]) :
    AdjoinRoot.mk P f = AdjoinRoot.mk P g ↔ P ∣ f - g

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mk_modByMonic
statement:
theorem mk_modByMonic (P f : K[X]) :
    AdjoinRoot.mk P (f %ₘ P) = AdjoinRoot.mk P f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_idealOfPolys
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_idealOfPolys {P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)}
    {f : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K} (hf : f ∈ idealOfPolys P) (x : Fin k → C)
    (hx : ∀ p ∈ P, MvPolynomial.aeval x p = 0) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval x f = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_idealOfPolys_iff
statement:
theorem mem_idealOfPolys_iff (P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) :
    f ∈ idealOfPolys P
      ↔ ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K, ∑ p ∈ P, A p * p = f

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Red_of_le
statement:
theorem Red_of_le (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)
    {α : Fin k →₀ ℕ} (G : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) (h : m.degree G ≤ α) :
    Red m P α G = P - monomial (α - m.degree G) (P.coeff α / m.leadingCoeff G) * G

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Red_of_not_le
statement:
theorem Red_of_not_le (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)
    {α : Fin k →₀ ℕ} (G : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) (h : ¬ m.degree G ≤ α) :
    Red m P α G = P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.reduction_standard_repr
statement:
theorem reduction_standard_repr (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k))
    (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) {P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K}
    (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P Q) :
    m.toSyn (m.degree Q) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree P) ∧
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K,
      (P - Q = ∑ G ∈ 𝒢, A G * G) ∧
      (∀ G ∈ 𝒢, m.toSyn (m.degree (A G * G)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree P))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.remark_4_66
statement:
theorem remark_4_66 (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    {P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K} (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P Q) :
    P - Q ∈ Ideal.span (↑𝒢 : Set _)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.remark_4_66_repr
statement:
theorem remark_4_66_repr (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    {P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K} (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P 0) :
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K, ∑ G ∈ 𝒢, A G * G = P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.remark_4_66_repr_degree
statement:
theorem remark_4_66_repr_degree (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k))
    (𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) {P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K}
    (h : ReducibleTo m 𝒢 P 0) :
    ∃ A : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K → MvPolynomial (Fin k) K,
      (∑ G ∈ 𝒢, A G * G = P) ∧
      (∀ G ∈ 𝒢, m.toSyn (m.degree (A G * G)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree P))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.sub_mem_span_of_isReduction
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_68
statement:
theorem proposition_4_68 (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)}
    {𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)} (hG : IsGrobnerBasisOf m I 𝒢)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_69
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.monSnoc_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem monSnoc_castSucc (α : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.monSnoc_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem monSnoc_last (α : Fin k →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    monSnoc α n (Fin.last k) = n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.monomial_one_dvd_one_iff
statement:
theorem monomial_one_dvd_one_iff (i j : Fin k →₀ ℕ) :
    ((monomial i 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) ∣ monomial j 1) ↔ i ≤ j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_62
statement:
theorem lemma_4_62 (B : Set (Fin k →₀ ℕ)) (_hB : ∀ a ∈ B, ∀ b, a ≤ b → b ∈ B) :
    {a | Minimal (· ∈ B) a}.Finite

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_70
statement:
theorem proposition_4_70 (m : MonomialOrder (Fin k)) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    ∃ 𝒢 : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K), IsGrobnerBasisOf m I 𝒢

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.theorem_4_61
statement:
theorem theorem_4_61 (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    ∃ P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K), I = idealOfPolys P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.corollary_4_71
statement:
theorem corollary_4_71 (I : ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) (hI : Monotone I) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m > n → I m = I n

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsQuasiMonic.leadingCoeff_const_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsQuasiMonic.leadingCoeff_const_ne_zero {P : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)}
    (hP : IsQuasiMonic P) : ∀ c : K, P.leadingCoeff = MvPolynomial.C c → c ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsQuasiMonic.ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsQuasiMonic.ne_zero {P : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)} (hP : IsQuasiMonic P) :
    P ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isFiniteMapping_fiber_finite
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.IsFiniteMapping.isFiniteMappingChain
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isFiniteMappingChain_succ
statement:
theorem isFiniteMappingChain_succ (C : Type*) [Field C] [Algebra K C] {k' d : ℕ}
    (P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin (k' + (d + 1))) K))
    (T : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k') K)) :
    IsFiniteMappingChain C k' (d + 1) P T ↔
      ∃ Q : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin (k' + d)) K),
        IsFiniteMapping C P Q ∧ IsFiniteMappingChain C k' d Q T

Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_75
statement:
theorem lemma_4_75 (B : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : Fin k → K, (∀ i, ∃ m : ℕ, m ≤ B.totalDegree ∧ z i = (m : K)) ∧
      MvPolynomial.eval z B ≠ 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.eval_topForm
statement:
theorem eval_topForm (a : Fin n → K) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    eval a (topForm P) = eval (Fin.cons 1 a) (homogeneousComponent P.totalDegree P)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isQuasiMonic_finSuccEquiv_shearHom
statement:
theorem isQuasiMonic_finSuccEquiv_shearHom (a : Fin n → K)
    {P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K} (hev : eval a (topForm P) ≠ 0) :
    IsQuasiMonic (finSuccEquiv K n (shearHom a P))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shearEquiv_apply (a : Fin n → K) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    shearEquiv a P = shearHom a P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearHom_comp_neg
statement:
theorem shearHom_comp_neg (a : Fin n → K) :
    (shearHom a).comp (shearHom (fun i => -a i)) = AlgHom.id K _

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearMap_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem shearMap_succ (a : Fin n → K) (i : Fin n) :
    shearMap a i.succ = X i.succ + C (a i) * X 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.shearMap_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shearMap_zero (a : Fin n → K) : shearMap a 0 = X 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.totalDegree_shearHom_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_shearHom_le (a : Fin n → K) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    (shearHom a P).totalDegree ≤ P.totalDegree

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gHom_Rbar
statement:
theorem gHom_Rbar (rest : List (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)) :
    gHom (Rbar rest) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range rest.length, Polynomial.C (rest.getD i 0) * Polynomial.X ^ i

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gHom_embedX0
statement:
theorem gHom_embedX0 (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) :
    gHom (embedX0 P) = Polynomial.C P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gHom_uVar
statement:
theorem gHom_uVar :
    gHom (uVar : Polynomial (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) = Polynomial.X

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.proposition_4_76
statement:
theorem proposition_4_76 {C : Type*} [Field C] [IsAlgClosed C] [Algebra K C]
    (P₁ : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K) (rest : List (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))
    (hqm : IsQuasiMonic (finSuccEquiv K n P₁)) :
    ∃ Proj : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
      (∀ Q ∈ Proj, MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ Q ∈ idealOfPolys (insert P₁ rest.toFinset)) ∧
      (Fin.tail : (Fin (n + 1) → C) → (Fin n → C)) ''
          zerOfFinset C (insert P₁ rest.toFinset) = zerOfFinset C Proj ∧
      IsFiniteMapping C (insert P₁ rest.toFinset) Proj

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_comp_algHom
statement:
theorem aeval_comp_algHom {N : ℕ}
    (τ : MvPolynomial (Fin N) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin N) K) (x : Fin N → C)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin N) K) :
    aeval x (τ P) = aeval (ptMap τ x) P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_zerOfFinset_image
statement:
theorem mem_zerOfFinset_image {N : ℕ} [DecidableEq (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)]
    (τ : MvPolynomial (Fin N) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)
    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)) (x : Fin N → C) :
    x ∈ zerOfFinset C (Ps.image τ) ↔ ptMap τ x ∈ zerOfFinset C Ps

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_zerOfFinset_image_equiv
statement:
theorem mem_zerOfFinset_image_equiv {N : ℕ} [DecidableEq (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)]
    (σ : MvPolynomial (Fin N) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)
    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin N) K)) (x : Fin N → C) :
    x ∈ zerOfFinset C (Ps.image σ) ↔ ptMap σ.toAlgHom x ∈ zerOfFinset C Ps

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homogeneousComponent_mul_homogeneous
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_homogeneous {k : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    {Q : MvPolynomial (Fin k) R} {e : ℕ} (hQ : Q.IsHomogeneous e) (m : ℕ) (hm : e ≤ m)
    (B : MvPolynomial (Fin k) R) :
    homogeneousComponent m (B * Q) = homogeneousComponent (m - e) B * Q

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gBound_le
statement: theorem gBound_le (d k : ℕ) : gBound d k ≤ (2 * d) ^ (2 ^ (k + 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gBound_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem gBound_succ (d k : ℕ) : gBound d (k + 1) = gBound (2 * d ^ 2) k

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.gBound_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gBound_zero (d : ℕ) : gBound d 0 = d

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.wBound_le
statement: theorem wBound_le (d m : ℕ) : wBound d m ≤ (2 * d) ^ (2 ^ m)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.wBound_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem wBound_succ (d m : ℕ) : wBound d (m + 1) = wBound (2 * d ^ 2) m + 3 * d ^ 2

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.wBound_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem wBound_zero (d : ℕ) : wBound d 0 = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.idealOfPolys_univariate_eq_span_gcd
statement:
theorem idealOfPolys_univariate_eq_span_gcd (P : Finset K[X]) :
    Ideal.span (↑P : Set K[X]) = Ideal.span {Azurite.BPR.listGcd P.toList}

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.idealOfPolys_univariate_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem idealOfPolys_univariate_isPrincipal (P : Finset K[X]) :
    (Ideal.span (↑P : Set K[X])).IsPrincipal

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.span_X_pair_not_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem span_X_pair_not_isPrincipal :
    ¬ (Ideal.span ({MvPolynomial.X 0, MvPolynomial.X 1} :
        Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K))).IsPrincipal

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_finset_zerOfIdeal
Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_zerOfIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_zerOfIdeal {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)} {x : Fin k → L} :
    x ∈ zerOfIdeal I ↔ ∀ P ∈ I, MvPolynomial.aeval x P = 0

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.zerOfIdeal_idealOfPolys
statement:
theorem zerOfIdeal_idealOfPolys (P : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    zerOfIdeal (L := L) (idealOfPolys P) = {x : Fin k → L | ∀ p ∈ P, MvPolynomial.aeval x p = 0}

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.evalBar_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalBar_mk (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) (x : Fin k → C)
    (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset C Ps) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k) C) :
    evalBar C Ps x hx (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = MvPolynomial.aeval x p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.idealOfPolysExt_eq_map
statement:
theorem idealOfPolysExt_eq_map (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    idealOfPolysExt C Ps
      = Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K C)) (idealOfPolys Ps)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.inclExt_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inclExt_mk (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) :
    inclExt C Ps (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)
      = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K C) p)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.valueAt_mk
statement:
theorem valueAt_mk (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)
    (x : Fin k → C) (hx : x ∈ zerOfFinset C Ps) :
    valueAt C Ps (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) x hx = MvPolynomial.aeval x p

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isZeroDimensional_iff
statement:
theorem isZeroDimensional_iff {C : Type*} [Field C] [Algebra K C]
    {Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)} :
    IsZeroDimensional C Ps ↔ (zerOfFinset C Ps).Nonempty ∧ (zerOfFinset C Ps).Finite

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.corner_one_val
statement: theorem corner_one_val (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : (1 : he.Corner).1 = e

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.mem_corner_iff_mul_eq
statement:
theorem mem_corner_iff_mul_eq (he : IsIdempotentElem e) {r : R} :
    r ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e ↔ e * r = r

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_includeRight
statement:
theorem algebraTensorAlgEquiv_includeRight (P : MvPolynomial (Fin k) K) :
    (algebraTensorAlgEquiv K C) (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight P)
      = MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K C) P

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.idealOfPolysExt_eq_map_tensor
statement:
theorem idealOfPolysExt_eq_map_tensor (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    idealOfPolysExt C Ps
      = Ideal.map (algebraTensorAlgEquiv K C)
          (Ideal.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) (idealOfPolys Ps))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_88
statement:
theorem lemma_4_88 (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) :
    Module.finrank K (quotPolys Ps) = Module.finrank C (quotPolysExt C Ps) ∧
      (FiniteDimensional K (quotPolys Ps) ↔ FiniteDimensional C (quotPolysExt C Ps))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_linearForm
statement:
theorem aeval_linearForm (i : ℕ) (x : Fin k → C) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval x (linearForm (K := K) i) = ∑ j : Fin k, (i : C) ^ (j : ℕ) * x j

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_90
statement:
theorem lemma_4_90 [CharZero K] (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K))
    (hfin : (zerOfFinset C Ps).Finite) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ (k - 1) * (hfin.toFinset.card).choose 2 ∧
      IsSeparating C Ps (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (linearForm (K := K) i))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.lemma_4_91
statement:
theorem lemma_4_91 (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin k) K)) (a : quotPolys Ps)
    (hsep : IsSeparating C Ps a) (hfin : (zerOfFinset C Ps).Finite) :
    LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin hfin.toFinset.card => a ^ (i : ℕ))
